Send closes compose and keeps the message in Outbox, a child of the collapsible All Account Mail section beside Inbox, until the undo delay ends (30 seconds unless a shorter one is set). Choosing the All Account Mail header only expands or collapses. Inbox opens the existing merged primary-folder list; Starred and Unread have separate aggregate rows. Local only, every mailbox. Undo cancels the queued send and saves an inert recovery draft before opening Compose. When Undo reopens Compose, the original reply's Agent todo stays linked and completes only after a confirmed send. If Compose cannot open, resume it from local Drafts; the recovery draft never sends automatically. Recovery failure leaves the queued send unchanged. Once delivery starts, Undo cannot cancel it. Opening a waiting message does not send it. After the delay, delivery starts. If the message was definitely not sent, it is saved in Drafts before Compose opens. If saving fails, the failed message stays in Scheduled mail for recovery. A partial delivery receipt stays open for review and is not a normal Outbox close. Quitting with a message still in Outbox asks first; it sends the next time Morrow is open. Restart and install waits while a message is still in Outbox. Zero undo delay sends immediately and skips Outbox. Uncertain submission keeps its content, Message-ID and recovery record in Scheduled delivery review across restart; check Sent and acknowledge recovery before creating a retry draft. It never auto-restores to an editable send. Entering Outbox retires earlier folder and search reads. A queue-read failure shows Unknown and Retry in Outbox, retaining any stale rows without claiming the queue is empty. Badges use body-free queue summaries. Outbox reads up to 200 summaries at a time; Next loads more. Opening an item fetches its full saved content on demand. Refreshing Scheduled also updates visible Outbox rows and the open message, even when the queue count is unchanged. These reads do not extend Undo or cancel delivery already in progress. Waiting messages show saved safe HTML and attachment names and sizes; remote images remain blocked. Attachment downloads are unavailable in Outbox.
